findings.title: `users` list bypasses private-profile get gate
findings.impact: Any signed-in user can list/query private profiles and read fields get would deny — privacy model collapse.
findings.scenario: As mallory: getDoc(private alice) fails; getDocs(users) or username prefix query returns alice.
findings.recommendation: Align list with canReadUserProfile or use a public projection collection; add emulator private-list deny.
findings.verification: Emulator: private profile excluded from unfiltered and prefix list queries.

findings.title: Client-writable workoutScore / streaks / stats (leaderboard integrity)
findings.impact: Any member can inflate score/streaks/PRs; leaderboard and social proof are untrusted.
findings.scenario: users/{uid}.update({ workoutScore: 999999 }) then open global leaderboard.
findings.recommendation: Server-authoritative score grants on session complete; deny client writes to integrity fields; hide or mark leaderboard until fixed.
findings.verification: Rules emulator deny owner workoutScore update; CF grants once per sessionId.

findings.title: derivedMode treats same-type cardio as turn-based
findings.impact: Two cardio partners get turn-based UI instead of parallel — core workout UX broken for a primary mode.
findings.scenario: Host+invitee both choose running → go-live → room uses turn-based branch.
findings.recommendation: Unify Session.derivedMode with derivePairedSessionMode (gym+gym turn-based else parallel); delete mode writes.
findings.verification: Unit matrix gym/gym, run/run, gym/run; manual paired cardio room.

findings.title: aps-environment hardcoded to development
findings.impact: Production/TestFlight may fail APNs entitlement or stay on sandbox — invites/turn pushes broken on iOS.
findings.scenario: Archive Release; inspect embedded entitlements; send prod push to TestFlight build.
findings.recommendation: Release entitlements with production; keep Debug on development; verify APNs key in Firebase.
findings.closureNote: Release/Profile use RunnerRelease.entitlements (production); Debug keeps development.

findings.title: workouts create allows forging another user history
findings.impact: Attacker can attribute workout docs to victims while including self in participants.
findings.scenario: setDoc(workouts/x, { userId: alice, participants: [mallory], sessionId }) expect deny.
findings.recommendation: Require userId == auth.uid for client creates; partner workouts via Admin/Functions.
findings.verification: Emulator forge deny; partner write via trusted path.

findings.title: matchmaking_queue claimer update has no field allowlist
findings.impact: Queue poisoning: rewrite userId/prefs or force bogus matched state.
findings.scenario: Alice waiting; mallory updates status and overwrites userId.
findings.recommendation: Restrict claimer keys; require claimedBy == auth.uid; emulator abuse tests.

findings.title: Session mode still written; derivation APIs disagree
findings.impact: Stored mode vs derivedMode diverge (cardio+cardio); analytics/rules still allow mode.
findings.scenario: Paired running session: written mode parallel, UI derivedMode turnBased (see Z-RT-001).
findings.recommendation: Delete session mode writes; remove mode from participantLiveKeys; single pure helper.
findings.verification: Grep gate: no mode under sessions writes; unit contract both helpers identical.

findings.title: No Firestore clearPersistence on sign-out / account switch
findings.impact: Next account on device may see prior user cached docs until refresh.
findings.scenario: User A sessions; sign out; User B on slow network — A docs may surface.
findings.recommendation: On sign-out: terminate + clearPersistence; re-init providers.
findings.verification: Integration: after sign-out local cache for prior uid empty.

findings.title: deliverNotificationPush has no rate limit / dedup
findings.impact: Authenticated caller can spam push cost and user notifications.
findings.scenario: Script repeated HTTPS calls with valid token+App Check.
findings.recommendation: Per-uid rate limit + dedup keys; consider Firestore triggers instead of client invoke.

findings.title: App Check verified without replay consumption; not enforceAppCheck
findings.impact: Manual verify without consume leaves replay window; weaker than platform enforce.
findings.scenario: Capture App Check token; replay push requests.
findings.recommendation: Use enforceAppCheck / consume; limited-use tokens.

findings.title: cleanupDeletedUser omits sessions, workouts, Storage, joint co-authorship
findings.impact: Account deletion leaves residual PII/media and social edges.
findings.scenario: Delete account; inspect sessions/workouts/Storage/joint slots remain.
findings.recommendation: Extend cleanup or document retention + Storage lifecycle; add export path.
findings.verification: Staging delete checklist empty for listed collections.

findings.title: switchTurn non-transactional; any participant may set activeUserId
findings.impact: Skipped turns / turn theft under race or malice.
findings.scenario: Concurrent switchTurn or partner writes activeUserId:self.
findings.recommendation: Transaction + rules require activeUserId == auth.uid for turn advance.

findings.title: Matchmaking ignores blocks; claiming can strand
findings.impact: Blocked users can still match; queue entries stuck claiming.
findings.recommendation: Filter blocks in claim; timeout reclaim claiming entries.
